title: What's Your Secret Codename?
description: Discover the classified identity that the universe has assigned you.
description_zh: 发现宇宙为你分配的隐藏身份。

questions.text: It's 3 AM and you receive an urgent message. What's your first reaction?
questions.text_zh: 凌晨3点，你收到一条紧急消息。你的第一反应是？

options.text: Jump into action immediately - duty calls
options.text_zh: 立即行动 - 使命在召唤

options.text: Assess the situation calmly and plan your response
options.text_zh: 冷静评估情况，制定应对方案

options.text: Question who's behind this and if it's a trap
options.text_zh: 质疑这是谁发的，是不是陷阱

options.text: Ignore it - nothing is worth losing sleep over
options.text_zh: 忽略它 - 没什么值得熬夜的

questions.text: You discover your best friend has been keeping a major secret from you. How do you handle it?
questions.text_zh: 你发现最好的朋友对你隐瞒了一个重大秘密。你会如何处理？

options.text: Confront them directly - transparency is essential
options.text_zh: 直接对质 - 透明度是必须的

options.text: Wait and observe - they'll reveal it when ready
options.text_zh: 等待观察 - 他们准备好了就会说

options.text: Use it as leverage - secrets are power
options.text_zh: 以此作为筹码 - 秘密就是力量
接受它 - 每个人都有隐私权

questions.text: What appeals to you most about spy movies?
questions.text_zh: 间谍电影最吸引你的是什么？

options.text_zh: 动作场面和黑科技道具

options.text: The thrill of staying under the radar

questions.text: If you had to choose a weapon for a secret mission, what would it be?
questions.text_zh: 如果你必须为秘密任务选择一件武器，你会选什么？

options.text: Quick and quiet - a silenced pistol
options.text_zh: 快速安静 - 带消音器的手枪
言语是我的武器 - 操控

questions.text: What's your ideal way to spend a weekend?
questions.text_zh: 你理想的周末是怎么度过的？

options.text: Deep work on a personal project

questions.text: In a group project, what's your role?
questions.text_zh: 在团队项目中，你扮演什么角色？

options.text_zh: 制定全盘计划的策略师

options.text: The wildcard who brings unexpected solutions
options.text_zh: 带来意外解决方案的奇兵

questions.text: How do you handle someone who threatens you?
questions.text_zh: 你如何对付威胁你的人？

options.text: Find their weakness and use it

options.text_zh: 消失 - 让 自己无法触及

questions.text_zh: 你对信任的看法是什么？

options.text_zh: 信任是通过行动赢得的

options.text: Trust is intuitive - I read people
options.text_zh: 信任是直觉性的 - 我看人很准

questions.text: If you could master any skill instantly, what would it be?
questions.text_zh: 如果你能瞬间掌握一项技能，你会选什么？
面对混乱时你的反应是什么？

options.text: I thrive in it - bring it on
options.text_zh: 我在混乱中如鱼得水 - 尽管来

options.text: I find order within the chaos
I use the chaos to my advantage
I step back and let it pass
options.text_zh: 我退后一步，让它自然平息

A.title: PHOENIX
A.description: You're the operative who operates in the shadows but strikes with blazing impact. Your codename reflects your ability to rise from any situation and bring fiery determination to every mission. You don't just complete missions - you make them legendary.
A.description_zh: 你是那种在暗处行动、但以炽烈冲击出击的特工。你的代号反映了你从任何困境中崛起的能力，以及在每次任务中带来炽烈决心的特质。你不只是完成任务 - 你让它们成为传奇。

B.title: VIGILANT
B.description: You're the master strategist who sees patterns others miss. Your codename reflects your unwavering watchfulness and calculated approach. You're the one who always has a plan B, C, and D. In your world, nothing happens by accident.
B.description_zh: 你是那种能看到别人忽略的模式的大师策略师。你的代号反映了你不变的警觉和精密规划的方法。在你的世界里，没有什么是偶然发生的。你总是有B、C、D计划。

C.title: WRAITH
C.description: You're the ultimate infiltrator - invisible, untraceable, and deadly efficient. Your codename reflects your ability to move through worlds without leaving a trace. People know you've been there only by the results you leave behind.
C.description_zh: 你是终极渗透者 - 无形、无法追踪、致命高效。你的代号反映了你穿梭于各种圈子而不留痕迹的能力。人们只知道你来过，因为你留下的是结果。

D.title: GHOST
D.description: You're the phantom who exists outside the system. Your codename reflects your philosophy of never being where you're expected to be. You work alone, vanish at will, and leave questions unanswered. The world sees you only if you want it to.
D.description_zh: 你是游离于系统之外的幽灵。你的代号反映了你的哲学 - 永远不在别人期望的地方出现。你独自行动，随意消失，留下未解之谜。这个世界只有在你愿意时才看得到你。
